summary: The agent saved an updated requirements document with 11 requirements, changing four (REQ-001, 002, 004, 005) and adding four (REQ-008 to 011), and removed the five questions the developer had already answered. Two questions remain open for the developer to decide: Q-006, whether display names are free-form and whether a taken name should be rejected or reused by a new browser, and Q-007, whether bidders may pick only CHF, EUR and USD for display or any currency Frankfurter supports. Both reads and writes of the requirements document succeeded, so no tool calls failed.
